variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'shall indeed bring me again' renders an emphatic doubled verb of the root shuv in the hiphil sense 'bring back'. The qere yashov (infinitive absolute) and the ketiv yashiv (hiphil imperfect) both yield the same English 'indeed bring me again'; nothing in the wording names one form over the other. The only notes are a gloss on Aram and an alternative_rendering on 'serve', neither of which touches this unit. Base fallback retained.
